newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM-KYMMENE SAYS STARTED US ADRS.
newsitem.headline: UPM-KYMMENE SAYS STARTED US ADRS.

text.p: Finnish forestry group UPM-Kymmene Oy said on Thursday it had launched a programme to trade American Depositary Receipts in its shares on U.S. OTC markets.
"The level 1 ADR programme does not mean that the company will become listed on the (New York) stock exchange," it said in a statement.

One UPM-Kymmene American Depositary Receipt (ADR) equals one UPM-Kymmene share, it said. Trade in the ADRs will be in dollars, the company said, adding this would make it easier for U.S. institutional and private investors to invest in the shares.
The depositary bank for the programme is Citibank N.A., part of Citicorp , and in Finland, Merita Bank, part of Merita Oy , will be custodian bank.
